gancho: Le pregunté a mi mejor amiga cómo me veía…
estilo: Cinematic Mexican telenovela look, warm dramatic lighting, shallow depth of field, subtle 35mm film grain, emotional close-ups, realistic people, natural Mexican Spanish acting
escenas: Luxurious bridal boutique with a big mirror. FERNANDA (26, light brown hair in an updo, white lace wedding dress) spins in front of the mirror while her best friend KARLA (26, black bob haircut, pink blouse) watches from a velvet sofa. Fernanda says: "¿Cómo me veo, amiga? Sé honesta."

Same bridal boutique. KARLA (26, black bob haircut, pink blouse) stands with teary eyes beside FERNANDA (26, white lace wedding dress, updo). Karla: "Te ves hermosa… él no te merece." Fernanda turns slowly from the mirror, confused.

Same boutique, close two-shot. KARLA (26, black bob, pink blouse) takes a deep breath, tears falling, while FERNANDA (26, white lace wedding dress) stares at her. Karla confesses: "Porque llevo tres años con él… y él no te lo iba a decir." Fernanda's bouquet drops to the floor.
caption: La verdad salió a días de la boda 💔 ¿La perdonarías? #novela #drama #historiascortas #telenovela #giro
